expected_object_inventory.requirement: Both templates must preserve every source object, kind, identity, order, page and reference, including the two cross-page objects; preserve source_text exactly.

expected_sequence.content: Beta-minus nuclear transformation; electrons are produced, not pre-existing nuclear constituents; proton number rises and neutron number falls while mass number stays unchanged; do not claim all bound neutrons are stable.
Same decay channel has a range of electron energies; apparent missing energy exposes an incomplete account, not a failure of energy conservation; include daughter recoil and the unobserved particle.

Pauli's missing neutral particle hypothesis; no-charge/zero-mass/impossible-ionization claims must be historically scoped or scientifically clarified. It is weak interaction, not exactly zero mass, that explains difficult detection.

A completely noninteracting entity would not provide a testable detection explanation; retain weak-but-not-zero interaction and penetrating matter without claiming undetectable energy literally vanishes.

Fermi's neutrino name and little-neutron meaning; retain source 0 and 300000 as historical assumptions/approximations, explicitly state that later oscillation evidence disproves the massless assumption; no present-day assertion that neutrinos necessarily have no rest frame or move exactly at light speed. Retain the Earth/glass analogy as qualitative.

Free-neutron decay and nuclear interactions; preserve historical approximate mean lifetime of 16 minutes, not half-life or a current precise value; distinguish stability in energetically stable nuclei from mere nuclear binding. Do not call neutrons elementary as a current fact.

Preserve neutrino and antineutrino symbols; beta-minus emits the electron antineutrino (source shorthand suppresses flavour). Do not make an unsupported universal claim that every particle has a distinct antiparticle.
Retain the complete forward beta-minus reaction unchanged.

Account for total initial energy, proton recoil/energy, electron energy and antineutrino energy; no frame-independent always-greater claim or implication that every decay gives the antineutrino the same excess energy.

Historical experimental discovery about 26 years later; observable interactions despite rarity; inverse beta decay is possible only with sufficient incoming antineutrino energy, not guaranteed whenever a proton is struck.
Retain the inverse beta reaction unchanged.

Reactor fission fragments undergo beta decay, producing many antineutrinos; preserve US 1956 historical setting, lead/paraffin shielding, 200 litres water, about 300 litres surrounding liquid scintillator; descriptive history, not a hands-on reactor procedure.

FIG277 labels A positron, B electron annihilation, C cadmium neutron capture; prompt two gamma quanta then delayed capture gamma signal; timing and backgrounds support detection, not an absolutely conclusive single pair; preserve ordering, media and signals.
Preserve shared fig-277 identity; no visual approval and no duplicate figure insertion.
Keep original caption identity; translate Figure 277 without changing the number.
Decay is a particle transformation, not proof of ordinary mechanical disassembly; neutron is now known to be composite. Do not deny composite-particle decay.

Retain broken-pot analogy and proton-electron hydrogen contrast, but do not use obsolete massless/light-speed reasoning to prove no constituents or imply emitted proton/electron necessarily bind into hydrogen.

Instability alone does not decide elementary/composite status; historically neutron considered elementary, now known composite; deuterium nucleus contains proton and neutron despite being stable. Keep atom/nucleus distinction.

forward_reaction.charge: Initial neutron is neutral; final positive proton and negative electron cancel, antineutrino neutral.
forward_reaction.electron_lepton_number: Electron and electron antineutrino have opposite electron lepton numbers; initial and final totals agree.
forward_reaction.energy_momentum: Energy and momentum include all three final particles; electron energy alone need not equal a fixed release.

inverse_reaction.charge: Positive proton on the left and positive positron on the right; other particles neutral.
inverse_reaction.electron_lepton_number: Electron antineutrino and positron have the same negative electron lepton number.
inverse_reaction.energy_momentum: Final neutron/positron rest masses and recoil require adequate initial energy; avoid adding a new numerical threshold.

independent_scientific_tests.mass: The retained Fermilab primary text explicitly says experiments observing neutrino type changes disproved the old massless belief. Historical wording is not a licence to omit that modern correction or teach light-speed necessity as present fact.
independent_scientific_tests.constituents: Fermilab distinguishes composite neutron/proton decays from elementary-particle decays. Instability is not itself evidence either way.
independent_scientific_tests.lifetime: Do not replace 16 or introduce a new modern measurement. Source uses mean lifetime, not half-life; historical approximate scoping is sufficient.
independent_scientific_tests.detector: Retain the prompt positron-annihilation and delayed cadmium-capture chain with adequate-energy and background qualifications; no image or experimental-apparatus certification.

historical_translation_requirements.note: Actual historical person; source Swiss description may be retained as source wording or clarified without fictional renaming.

historical_translation_requirements.requirements: Every actual historical name/place kept in candidate text must have the corresponding source-bound historical_entities entry; English uses term/source_term and translation in changes. Do not invent historical identities or treat a declaration as proof of science.

section_requirements.boundaries: Adjacent final-paragraph before/after anchors at genuine conceptual switches; source object boundaries alone are not numerical paragraph indices. Keep equations with their explanations and figure with its detector reference.
section_requirements.limit: No prose_flow command, renderer, validator or browser preview permitted in this bounded review. Textual anchor inspection can be reported separately from authoritative final-flow/render verification.

forbidden_actions_and_preserved_holds.approval_scope: Text/science findings only. Code-generated equality is supplementary integrity evidence, never scientific approval.
